name: Grand Marché Rood Woko
subtitle: Rood Woko, the central market of Ouagadougou, moved to its present 3.6 ha site in 1954.

parts.text: Rood Woko, the central market of Ouagadougou, moved to its present 3.6 ha site in 1954. Its reconstruction was decided on 26 August 1985, a company was created in 1988 to manage it, and a fire swept through the market in 2003.
